description: Find businesses in a US city that take walk-ins, with how long the wait is right now. Open places come first, shortest wait first. Optionally narrow to one kind of business with `trade`: barbershops (barbershop), hair-salons (hair salon), nail-salons (nail salon), brow-and-lash (brow and lash studio), massage-and-spas (massage studio or spa), tattoo-shops (tattoo shop), pet-groomers (pet groomer), vet-clinics (vet clinic), chiropractors (walk-in chiropractor), tax-preparers (tax preparation office), auto-repair (auto repair shop), car-washes (car wash), phone-repair (phone repair shop). Returns at most 10 places, each with its slug, wait and a link to join the line. Start here when you don't have a place's slug yet; use get_place for one place's full details. If nothing is listed in that city (or for that trade), it says so instead of returning places.

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. TX

trade.description: Optional kind of business, one of the slugs listed in the tool description
